name: Pydio Cells
description: Pydio Cells is a self-hosted document sharing and collaboration platform. It organizes files into workspaces with fine-grained permissions, public and private share links, versioning and automated flows, and connects desktop sync and mobile clients.

notes.text: Open https://<IP>:8080 and accept the self-signed certificate, the web UI needs HTTPS. Log in as admin with the password from /opt/pydio-cells_data/.env.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: Password of the admin account, without single quotes. Generated when left empty
